Fundraising is a skill you need to realize your projects: fiscal sponsorship is the tool that makes fundraising possible.

Through fiscal sponsorship, you can leverage some of the benefits of Fractured Atlas’s tax-exempt status toaccess discounted space, solicit tax-deductible donations, and apply for funding from corporations and foundations.
WHAT IS FISCAL SPONSORSHIP?
In other words: we built an entire organization so that you don’t have to AND you can use our organization to catalyze your creativity.
Raise funds. Motivate donors. Create something excellent. Handle your business.
WHAT CAN YOU DO WITH FISCAL SPONSORSHIP?

Fiscal sponsorship allows you to use the tools we offer to support your work. We know that there’s no “one-size-fits-all” solution and you are the expert on what you’re creating. You can use any or all of our tools to customize the support you need. With fiscal sponsorship, you can:
Solicit funds which are eligible for tax-deduction to your donors.
